goal: Allow importing public descriptors into a wallet when the wallet already holds the private keys
Users no longer need to expose sensitive private key material in RPC calls when importing
agreement: General support for avoiding manual handling of private keys (rkrux, polespinasa, Sjors)
Suggested an alternative approach giving the parser access to wallet extended keys (Sjors)
Objection: re-importing an existing descriptor creates a duplicate entry (fametrano)
Unaddressed objection: missing array header include causes an IWYU failure (fametrano)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it removes the need to expose private key material over RPC during descriptor imports
Solves a long-standing issue for users managing private-key-enabled descriptor wallets
